source_refs.note: Error Bars: a main subheading of 22.3.2 Pie Chart, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 201-203.

blocks.text: Error bars graph par lagi chhoti lakeerein hain jo bar charts (aur doosre plots) par data ka farq (variability) ya ghair yaqeeni pan (uncertainty) dikhati hain. In se pata chalta hai ke alag alag qeematein bar ki dikhayi gayi markazi qeemat (maslan mean) se aam taur par kitni door hoti hain.
Bar chart par error bars banane ke do sab se aam tareeqe:
Range error bars har bar ke liye group ki sab se chhoti (minimum) aur sab se bari (maximum) qeemat istemal karti hain. Lakeer minimum se maximum tak jati hai aur data ka poora phailao dikhati hai.

SD error bars dikhati hain ke qeematein mean se ausatan kitni door hain. Bar chart par har bar aik group ka mean hota hai; SD error bars mean se aik (ya zyada) standard deviation oopar aur neeche jati hain (±SD).
Bar chart par error bars banane ke qadam (misaal)

Researchers teen alag roshniyon mein paudon ki ausat unchai (cm) naap rahe hain. Woh bean (lobia) ke paude teen groups mein ugate hain: Group A kam roshni, Group B darmiyani roshni, Group C zyada roshni. Chaar hafton baad paudon ki unchai naapi jati hai.

blocks.caption: Chaar hafte baad bean paudon ki unchai (cm)

items: Qadam 1: har group ka mean: A = (10 + 11 + 9)/3 = 10 cm, B = (14 + 16 + 15)/3 = 15 cm, C = (18 + 20 + 19)/3 = 19 cm. Bars 10, 15 aur 19 ki unchai tak bante hain.

Qadam 2: phailao nikalein. SD error bars ke liye har group ki SD = √(2/3) ≈ 0.82 cm (taqreeban 1 cm; kitab 1 likhti hai). Range error bars ke liye: A min 9, max 11; B min 14, max 16; C min 18, max 20.

Qadam 3: error bars banayein. SD error bar: mean (bar ki chhat) se 1 cm oopar aur 1 cm neeche (mean ± 1 SD): A 9 se 11, B 14 se 16, C 18 se 20. Range error bar: har group ke minimum se maximum tak. Har sire par chhoti ufqi topi (cap) lagayein.

blocks.caption: Paudon ki naap ka statistical khulasa (kitab ka table)

blocks.alt: Safaid bars: Group A (mean 10), Group B (15), Group C (19); y-axis Mean, 0 se 25. Har bar par do topi wale error bars saath saath: surkh SD (jama/minus) error aur neela Range (jama/minus) error, dono mean se 1 oopar aur 1 neeche. Legend: SD (+/-) error surkh, Range (+/-) error neela.
blocks.caption: Mukhtalif roshni mein paudon ki ausat unchai, error bars ke saath (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Har group ke bar par do error bars hain: surkh SD error bar aur neela range error bar. Is data mein dono 1 cm hain, is liye dono barabar lambe hain. Group C ka bar sab se ooncha hai: zyada roshni mein paude sab se zyada barhe.

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke blood types ke zawiye mil kar poora daira banate hain.
Jangal ke darakhton mein har species ka feesad dikhane ke liye kaun sa chart behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: Pie chart, kyunke yeh poore (tamam darakhton) ke hisse dikhata hai.

items: Pie chart: sector angle = (qisam ki qeemat / total) × 360°; poora daira 360°.
X-axis data figure: x par independent, y par dependent variable; sahih scale, nuqte lakeer se jore.
Error bars: range (min se max) ya mean ± SD, siron par topi (cap).
